title: The Crooked Oath
premise: Yara Blackwood, a beast-speaker masquerading as a humble charm-seller in the magic-outlawed city of Vell, discovers the old gods are answering prayers again — and that his own gift is the key they've been waiting for. Hunted by the Order of the Iron Seal and courted by a resurgent divine faction, Yara must choose between exposing the truth that could free magic and destroy the fragile peace, or burying it forever. When he learns the gods' return was engineered by someone he loves, he breaks his crooked oath of silence, triggering a confrontation at the city's heart where loyalty, love, and identity collide. In the end, Yara sacrifices his gift to bind the warring gods into a new covenant, choosing to become an ordinary man in a world finally allowed to be extraordinary.
about_author: Jude Zhou is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing folk charms before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about people who carry dangerous truths quietly.

chapters.title: The Charm Seller's Morning
chapters.summary: Yara Blackwood sells a luck-charm to a frightened widow while suppressing the whisper of a stray cat only he can hear. POV: Yara. Establishes his double life and the suffocating quiet of Vell; emotional beat: loneliness disguised as contentment.

chapters.title: Prayer Answered
chapters.summary: A beggar's desperate prayer at a dead shrine is audibly answered — a stone god opens one eye. Yara witnesses it and flees, but the cat follows him home speaking in an old tongue. POV: Yara. Beat: dread cracking open wonder.

chapters.title: Iron Seal
chapters.summary: Order investigator Captain Serah Voss interrogates charm-sellers after rumors of miracles. Yara lies smoothly, but Voss marks him. POV: Voss. Introduces the antagonist's rigid conviction; beat: the hunter's cold certainty.

chapters.title: What the Rats Know
chapters.summary: Yara uses his gift to question the city's rats and learns shrines are waking across Vell — and something beneath the temple district is stirring first. POV: Yara. Beat: the secret grows heavier than he can carry alone.

chapters.title: The God Beneath
chapters.summary: Yara descends into sealed catacombs following the animals' warnings and meets Maren, a priestess of the old faith who has waited seven years for a beast-speaker. POV: Yara. Beat: reluctant alliance born of shared danger.

chapters.title: Seven Years of Silence
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter: how Yara's mother died for her magic and how he swore his crooked oath never to speak with beasts again. POV: Yara. Beat: grief explaining his fear; the oath given its full weight.

chapters.title: Voss Closes In
chapters.summary: Voss traces the waking shrines and finds Maren's name in old seizure records. She raids the catacombs; Yara barely escapes with Maren wounded. POV: alternating Yara/Voss. Beat: pursuit sharpens; no safe ground remains.

chapters.title: A Debt in Feathers
chapters.summary: A crow Yara once healed repays him by hiding them in the rookery of exiled mage Tam Ossler, who recognizes what Yara is and what it means. POV: Yara. Beat: found family forming around a secret.

chapters.title: The Gods' Bargain
chapters.summary: Through Maren's rites, the waking god Ashen-Vey speaks: it will shield the faithful if a beast-speaker carries its covenant to every shrine in Vell within nine days. POV: Yara. Beat: duty offered like a trap.

chapters.title: Tam's Heresy
chapters.summary: Tam argues the gods' return feels manufactured — too convenient, too timed. Yara refuses to listen, already half in love with the purpose the covenant gives him. POV: Tam. Beat: doubt planted by a friend.

chapters.title: Serah's Wound
chapters.summary: Voss confronts a miracle she cannot explain — a dying child healed at a shrine — and her faith in the Iron Seal fractures. POV: Voss. Beat: the antagonist begins to bend toward truth.

chapters.title: Nine Shrines, Nine Nights
chapters.summary: Yara journeys through Vell's districts carrying the covenant, each shrine-waking drawing crowds and Order patrols closer. The cat reveals fragments of its true nature. POV: Yara. Beat: rising momentum, mounting exposure.

chapters.title: The Cat Speaks Plainly
chapters.summary: The cat confesses: it is a fragment of the goddess Nethra, and it chose Yara years ago — his mother's death was not random but a culling of speakers. POV: Yara. Beat: betrayal inside companionship; identity shaken.

chapters.title: Maren's Confession
chapters.summary: Cornered by Tam's evidence, Maren admits she helped wake the gods deliberately, believing only war could restore magic — and that she used Yara as the vessel. POV: Maren. Beat: love against duty inverted; trust shatters.

chapters.title: Crooked Oath Broken
chapters.summary: Yara, furious, considers handing everything to Voss to end it. Instead he speaks aloud to every animal in Vell at once, asking their help — breaking his oath and revealing himself. POV: Yara. Beat: liberation and terror entwined.

chapters.title: The City Hears
chapters.summary: Beasts across Vell answer: pigeons shadow patrols, dogs block raids, and word spreads among the hidden faithful that a speaker walks. Voss realizes the 'criminal' is the city itself. POV: Voss. Beat: the hunted becomes the movement.

chapters.title: Ashen-Vey's True Face
chapters.summary: At the final shrine, Ashen-Vey drops its mask: it intends to purge the Order and crown Yara as its voice-king, whether he consents or not. POV: Yara. Beat: the savior revealed as conqueror; stakes turn existential.

chapters.title: Nethra's Price
chapters.summary: Nethra offers Yara a counter-covenant: give up his gift entirely and the gods can be bound into peace rather than war. He must decide before dawn. POV: Yara. Beat: the cost made flesh — lose himself or lose everyone.

chapters.title: The Temple District Burns
chapters.summary: Ashen-Vey's faithful storm the temple district; Voss must choose between her Order and the truth. She turns her seal-blade on her own commander to save civilians. POV: Voss. Beat: redemption paid in treason.

chapters.title: Climax: The Crooked Oath
chapters.summary: At the shattered great shrine, Yara faces Ashen-Vey, Maren's faction, and the Order at once. Speaking his mother's name, he accepts Nethra's price and pours his gift into binding all the gods into a new covenant. POV: Yara. Beat: sacrifice as climax; silence falls over Vell.

chapters.title: After the Silence
chapters.summary: Magic is decriminalized under the new covenant; Maren faces judgment, Tam rebuilds, and Voss resigns to guard the shrines honestly. Yara wakes unable to hear the cat — now just a cat — and grieves. POV: Yara. Beat: bittersweet reckoning.

chapters.title: An Ordinary Man
chapters.summary: One year later, Yara sells real charms in a legal shop. A stray cat sits on his windowsill; he cannot hear it, but it stays anyway. He smiles, ordinary at last in an extraordinary world. POV: Yara. Beat: resolution — identity chosen, love outlasting the gift.
